scope: Reverse incorrect Evasive cost correction from Batch 239

corrections.name: Final Pose
corrections.why: Current Xenoverse 2 Evasive Skill reference explicitly lists Final Pose at 200 Stamina and Skill Shop. Batch 239 incorrectly substituted a generic/older Xenoverse reference value.

corrections.name: Mach Dash
corrections.why: Current Xenoverse 2 Evasive Skill reference explicitly lists Mach Dash at 200 Stamina and PQ18. Batch 239 incorrectly substituted a generic/older Xenoverse reference value.

reconciliation_note: Batch 239 is superseded only for the Final Pose and Mach Dash stamina fields. Its broader lesson remains valid: individual current XV2 records should outrank generic prose, but the current XV2 Evasive table itself is the appropriate source for these two values.
